options: transfer of pollen grains from a stigma to an anther
fusion of a pollen nucleus with a nucleus in an ovule
transfer of pollen grains from an anther to a stigma
transfer of pollen grains from an anther to an ovary
questions.why: Pollination is anther → stigma; fertilisation is the fusion of nuclei.

questions.q: Where does fertilisation usually occur in humans?
questions.why: The egg is released into the oviduct, where it meets sperm; the embryo then implants in the uterus.

questions.q: Which condition is not needed for seeds to germinate?
questions.why: Germination needs water, oxygen and a suitable temperature, but not light.

questions.q: State one adaptive feature of a sperm cell and explain how it helps.
questions.model: Flagellum – to swim to the egg. (Or: many mitochondria – release energy for swimming; acrosome enzymes – digest the jelly coat of the egg.)
points: a correct feature (flagellum, mitochondria or acrosome enzymes)
